claim_boundary: This artifact defines the CONJECTURED CRR-U universal-incompatibility target. It proves only exact source-bound exponent compatibility and formal integrity; it proves no incompatibility, construction, density estimate, short-interval theorem, or method saturation.

classification.falsifier: A sequence of integers v_j tending to infinity with one common-pair witness (b^(j),W_j) at every v_j.
classification.finite_witness_policy: A finite witness neither proves nor refutes the asymptotic statement.
classification.statement: There exists v0 such that no witness exists for any integer v>=v0.

smooth_functions.eta: eta(x)=0 for x<=0; eta(x)=exp(-1/x) for x>0

exact_source_bound_compatibility.implication: No contradiction is available from these displayed exponent upper bounds alone.
exact_source_bound_compatibility.non_implication: Exponent compatibility does not construct common coefficients or a common W and does not prove sharpness.

gate.promotion_rule: PASS-INCOMPATIBLE requires a universal theorem; PASS-COMPATIBLE requires an explicit asymptotic family and all simultaneous estimates.

independent_analytic_obligations: uniform Base(v) pointwise and separation hypotheses
signed cubic convergence, reality, positivity, and size
uniform handling of delta(v) and every source subpower loss
two independent proof routes or a documented mechanism-specific reason independence is impossible

resource_policy.failed_row_rule: No rows may be generated under v1. Any computation represented as CRR evidence is an unauthorized exploratory result and cannot be promoted.
resource_policy.future_search_rule: A new versioned preregistration must freeze all families, ranges, seed, cap, failed-row handling, and rigorous margin before any finite probe.

source_status.gm_displayed_bounds: PROVED from pinned source under their stated hypotheses; used only for exact exponent compatibility
source_status.gm_rational_remark: OBSERVED heuristic example, not a predicate and not a consequence of energy
source_status.new_rational_predicate: CONJECTURED diagnostic definition; no source attribution
source_status.positive_cubic_lower_bound: CONJECTURED simultaneous witness condition; source supplies upper bounds only

base.pointwise: |D_v(t)| >= v^(7-delta(v)) for every t in W

witness_schema.common_object_rule: One common pair (b,W) must satisfy Base(v), RationalMass(v), and PositiveCubic(v); no separately optimized W is admissible.

positive_cubic.I_m: L^3 times the W^3 sum of the three cyclic Fourier factors at m_i L
positive_cubic.S3_signed: sum over integer triples with m1*m2*m3 nonzero
positive_cubic.convergence: absolute for each finite W by rapid Fourier decay of fixed compactly supported smooth h_t
positive_cubic.reality: conjugation plus simultaneous t-order reversal and m -> -m
